customManagers.description: Chart appVersion is the Hermes Agent image tag; same dependency, so it lands in the same PR as agent.image.tag

packageRules.description: Every image bump is a chart change: bump the chart's patch version with it, ready to tag
Majors can break agents or migrate data (Hindsight's Postgres, Open WebUI's DB); hold them on the Dependency Dashboard until approved
Hermes Agent is 0.x: a minor can change config or CLI behaviour the box script relies on, so each minor is its own PR

hindsight.userUi is Hindsight's UI rebuilt with a patch and tagged with Hindsight's version: bump them in one PR. Until the patched build of a version exists, the PR bumps only Hindsight and the per-person UI stays on its older version
